company.name: NovaStore
company.description: A fictional e-commerce company used for the ResolveAI customer-support demonstration.

policies.title: Standard Shipping
policies.content: Standard orders are normally delivered within 3 to 7 business days after dispatch.

policies.title: Order Tracking
policies.content: Customers can use the tracking number provided after dispatch to check the latest available shipment status. ResolveAI does not have direct access to live carrier or order-tracking systems.

policies.title: Return Policy
policies.content: Eligible products may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Items should be returned in their original condition with the included accessories.

policies.title: Refund Processing
policies.content: After an approved return is processed, refunds normally take 5 to 7 business days to appear on the original payment method.

policies.title: Payment Problems
policies.content: If a payment fails, customers should verify their payment information and available funds before trying again. ResolveAI cannot access or modify payment details.

policies.title: Unauthorized Transaction
policies.content: Suspected unauthorized transactions require human assistance. Customers should avoid sharing complete card numbers, passwords, PINs, or other sensitive authentication information in chat.

policies.title: Product Warranty
policies.content: Eligible products include a 12-month limited warranty covering qualifying manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered by the standard limited warranty.

policies.title: Account Access
policies.content: Customers who cannot access their account should use the password-reset option associated with their registered email address. ResolveAI cannot view, retrieve, or change customer passwords.

policies.title: Order Cancellation
policies.content: An order may be eligible for cancellation before it enters the dispatch process. Once dispatched, the customer may need to follow the applicable return process instead.
